updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security General Availability
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security is now generally available, integrating with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer across text, files, and AI interactions. Admins can now enforce DLP policies and detect risky activity through Insider Risk Management across browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms without manual per-app configuration.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps in Preview
updates.summary: DLP policies can now be created and enforced against data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends Purview's classification engine and policy controls beyond the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, helping organizations protect sensitive data across hybrid SaaS environments.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP Permission Changes for macOS 27 Preparation
updates.summary: Organizations must deploy Endpoint DLP client version 101.26072 or later and configure protection modes to prepare for upcoming permission changes in macOS 27. Admins need to monitor permission status and notify users of required Device Control and Data Access permission changes to maintain DLP coverage on Apple devices.

updates.title: Cross-Tenant Teams DLP Policy Enforcement Follows Initiating Tenant
updates.summary: DLP policy enforcement in cross-tenant Microsoft Teams chats and channels now follows the tenant that initiated the conversation rather than applying each user's home-tenant policies. Admins should review DLP policies to ensure coverage is maintained for cross-tenant collaboration scenarios.

updates.title: 30-Day Delay Hold Auto-Applied to Inactive Mailboxes
updates.summary: When the last hold is removed from an inactive mailbox, Microsoft 365 now automatically applies a 30-day delay hold to prevent accidental mailbox deletion. Admins must identify and remove delay holds before recalculating mailbox hold status to avoid unintended retention changes.

updates.title: Priority Cleanup for Permanent SharePoint and OneDrive File Deletion in Preview
updates.summary: Admins can now permanently delete selected SharePoint and OneDrive files using Priority Cleanup, which bypasses recycle bins and removes files from search discoverability after simulation, review, and approval. This capability enables faster data lifecycle management and compliance-driven cleanup at scale.

updates.title: Data Security Investigations Integration with Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Admins can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by automatically gathering related files that triggered alerts. This integration reduces manual investigation time and improves incident response for data loss scenarios.

updates.title: Purview DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer in Development
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management is adding Copilot readiness assessment and data explorer capabilities to provide visibility into data security posture, sensitive data exposure, and oversharing. These tools will help security teams prioritize remediation and assess organizational readiness for Microsoft Copilot deployments.

updates.title: Adaptive Protection Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Adaptive Protection in Purview will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user's dynamic insider risk level. This integration automates data protection for high-risk users by connecting insider risk assessment with data lifecycle policies.

updates.title: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report in Development
updates.summary: Admins will gain visibility into auto-labeling enforcement progress through per-policy coverage reports that compare current enforcement volumes against the latest simulation snapshot. This helps identify labeling gaps and files processed during enforcement that were not included in simulations.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Temporary File Noise Reduction in Development
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management will enhance temporary file exclusions to reduce high-volume, low-signal noise from operating system and application activities on Windows endpoints. This update will improve signal-to-noise ratio without requiring overly broad exclusion rules.

updates.title: Automated Deletion of Inactive OneDrives and Mailboxes for Departed Employees
updates.summary: Admins can now automate the deletion of both content and containers for departed users at scale to maintain regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This capability streamlines offboarding workflows and reduces compliance risk from retained departed-employee data.

updates.title: eDiscovery In-Product Diagnostics for Self-Service Troubleshooting
updates.summary: eDiscovery admins gain self-service diagnostics to identify common configuration issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The feature highlights potential misconfigurations and provides guidance to resolve challenges without requiring support escalation.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Purview now provides insights and policy recommendations based on sensitive data detected in OneDrive and SharePoint to help organizations govern sensitive data better. These recommendations guide admins toward appropriate retention policies for improved data security and compliance posture.

updates.title: DLP Unmanaged Cloud App Discovery Integration with Island Enterprise Browser
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Island Enterprise Browser to extend DLP protection to browser-based workflows and unmanaged cloud app interactions. Organizations can detect and protect data shared with unmanaged apps using existing Purview classifiers, sensitive information types, and sensitivity labels.

updates.title: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Will Become Teams-Only for Copilot Separation
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams that currently also cover Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, no longer governing Copilot workloads implicitly. Admins should review and update retention policies to explicitly cover Copilot if needed.

updates.title: Remove Retention Hold from Unlicensed OneDrive Sites via PowerShell
updates.summary: Admins can now remove retention holds from unlicensed OneDrive sites using Security & Compliance PowerShell, enabling site deletion without license dependencies. Updated guidance covers tenant-level and site-level holds, prerequisites, and common blocking errors.

updates.title: Data Quality Capability Regional Co-Location Requirement
updates.summary: The Purview Data Quality capability now requires that the Microsoft Purview account and its connected data sources reside in the same Azure region. Organizations with multi-region deployments should verify regional alignment to maintain data quality assessment capability.
